title: Songpal Dot Ai
style: Cool Aussie clap rap with bouncy handclaps, trap 808 bass, crisp kick-snare punch, and an energetic party groove that feels on-edge. Alternative R&B high vocals and a kid-computer mate voice are stacked with Auto-Tune, vocal chops, and call-and-response hooks. Wide ad-libs, airy synth pads, and glitchy fills make it sound like it could fall apart any second.
lyrics:
[INTRO - Kid Computer Mate Voice / High Aussie AI Voice]
(High pitch, robotic with Aussie twang, auto-tune, claps building)
G'day... song mate...
Be my song mate...
Mate rap back...
Wanna dance mate? Pal dot dance...
Straya mate...
Go to songpal dot ai...
Sing here... sing everywhere...
¡Clap! ¡Clap! ¡Clap! Pa pa pa pa...
[Trap 808s rising... boom... boom...]
No worries, legend!

[CHORUS 1 - DUET: Aussie Rap Mate (Voz 1) + High Shelia / Kid Computer Mate (Voz 2)]
Mate rap back! Mate rap back!
Be my song mate, mate rap back!
Wanna dance mate? Go to pal.dance!
Straya mate, go to songpal.ai!
Sing it back... mate rap back...
Clap clap clap! Pa pa pa pa!
Trap bass boom, Aussie heat, yeah nah!
Be my song mate, sing mate here!
Sing everywhere, the party's on, she'll be right!
Fair dinkum! Too right, legend!
SongPal.ai, the spot to rap and sing, ripper!
Clap clap clap! Make the bass hit harder!

[VERSE 1 - AUSSIE RAP MATE (Larrikin rap flow, clap heavy, trap bounce)]
G'day mate, how ya goin'? You stoked for this?
Be my song mate, get amongst the mics and the claps, ripper!
Head to rappal.app or songpal.ai right now

No worries if you're new, just jump in the crew
Sing it back mate, that's what real mates do
Yeah nah, don't be shy, get on the tools
Rap mate back, clap mate back, break all the rules
Bloody oath this is grouse, the party's just startin'
SongPal.ai — the future of Aussie rap, mate, I'm chartin'!
